calibration.fitted_on: walkaround runs A, B, B2, tex1, tex2 on the flat matte bench board, one phone, one board; not a general constant

notes.qualifying_mm: The bench's required-bolt threshold: the 3.2 mm bolt is the stand-in for the 1/8 in (3.175 mm) limit. Score.py's Gate A counts targets at or above this.
notes.low_mm: Starting guess. Targets under this are reported next to Gate A, not part of it.
notes.match_radius_mm: Starting guess. A candidate within this distance of a target hits it.
notes.flag_min_est_mm: The walkaround's detection cut (score.py --min-est profile). About 2.1 mm true height through the calibration above, deliberately under the limit so borderline bumps get flagged. Picked on two runs, held on two others.
